title: MCode visual world
question: The roll assigned Test Bench. Keep it, take an alternate, re-roll, or take the category standard.

options.label: Test Bench
options.lineage: Electronics workbench instruments: oscilloscope, bench supply, signal generator
options.thesis: MCode is a calibrated measurement instrument for your agent fleet: every agent is a channel, every run a trace.
materials: powder-coated faceplates, silkscreened legends, engraved hairlines
scope graticule behind graphs; LED status windows; four-trace channel coding (Ch1 yellow, Ch2 cyan, Ch3 magenta, Ch4 green) assigned to agents/worktrees
options.viewport: App shell as instrument panel: left rail is the channel strip (trace-color LEDs + live activity meters per worktree/agent), center surface sits on a faint graticule, top bar reads like a scope header with Run/Hold semantics for agent state.
options.risk: Instrument skeuomorphs could feel gimmicky if pushed past micro-details; the counter-move is calm chrome with the character living in readouts, tabular numerals, and channel color discipline.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.lineage: green-phosphor CRT in a midnight machine room
options.thesis: The whole app is one continuous glowing transcript.
options.case: Highest instant identification with terminal culture, but it IS the AI-tool monoculture - near-black plus neon glow is exactly the cluster every agent tool ships; fuses poorly because MCode's value is the orchestration surface around terminals, not only the terminal.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: carbon-copy airline coupons and baggage tags
options.thesis: Every agent run is a coupon leg that tears off when done; states stamp, nothing vanishes.
options.case: Beautiful fit for run-history and DONE/VOID state stamps, but fuses poorly at density: coupon chrome eats vertical space a 20-worktree sidebar cannot spare.

options.label: One-Bit Desktop
options.thesis: Two colors, dither for everything, marching ants for selection.
options.case: Memorable and technically playful (steps() animations), but two-color grammar cannot carry diff colors, git-lane semantics, or agent status without breaking its own law; wrong trade for a daily-driver Operate tool.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What every dev-tool ships - Linear-grade dark minimalism - executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement you expect from a modern IDE, at full craft.
